narrative.intro: Johns Hopkins University Applied Physics Laboratory obligated $85.3M in FY2027 to date across 6 awards, with an average award size of $14.2M. Obligations fell down 96.0% year over year compared with prior fiscal totals. Johns Hopkins University Applied Physics Laboratory recorded FY22 obligations of $1.6B, FY23 obligations of $2B, FY24 obligations of $2B, FY25 obligations of $2.4B, and FY26 obligations of $2.1B. National Aeronautics and Space Administration is the top buying agency in FY2027 to date with $85.3M in obligations. The Department of Homeland Security shows $0 in obligations for FY2027 to date. Current-year totals are partial and cover the fiscal year to date. The note clarifies that figures are contract obligations except award-value figures in the largest-awards and expiring-contracts tables, which are total contract values. Use these figures to compare activity across years and agencies, and to gauge the scale of FY2027 federal buying relative to recent fiscal years.
